name: prometheus.exporter.databricks

arguments.name: client_id
arguments.description: The OAuth2 Application ID or Client ID of your Service Principal.

arguments.name: client_secret
arguments.description: The OAuth2 Client Secret of your Service Principal.

arguments.name: server_hostname
arguments.description: The Databricks workspace hostname, for example, dbc-xxx.cloud.databricks.com.

arguments.name: warehouse_http_path
arguments.description: The HTTP path of the SQL Warehouse for example, /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc123.

arguments.name: billing_lookback
arguments.description: How far back to look for billing data.

arguments.name: collect_task_retries
arguments.description: Collect task retry metrics. Can cause high cardinality due to the task_key label.

arguments.name: jobs_lookback
arguments.description: How far back to look for job runs.

arguments.name: pipelines_lookback
arguments.description: How far back to look for pipeline runs.

arguments.name: queries_lookback
arguments.description: How far back to look for SQL warehouse queries.

arguments.name: sla_threshold_seconds
arguments.description: Duration threshold in seconds for job SLA miss detection.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
